messages:
aria: HelioHealth POC hitting intermittent SSE truncation on Android SDK during staging demos. They see JSON parse errors mid-stream. Demo tomorrow AM, need quick triage.

samir: Which SDK/version and route?

aria: Android SDK v0.9.3, route /v1/stream/generate, model=open-sim-13b. Client error: 'org.json.JSONException: Unterminated object'.

priya: paste server log for failing conn and any client stack.

aria: server snippet:
2026-03-18T14:22:24Z ERR stream_chunk_incomplete conn=abcd1234 last_event_len=14 expected_event_end="\n\n"

samir: sounds like mid-event flush (CDN/proxy). Short-term: (1) client: buffer until blank-line delimiter and use incremental UTF-8 decode; (2) server: append a small sentinel event after logical chunks.

priya: opening runtime ticket for optional sentinel and SDK ticket for Android decoder.

ops-bot: Created INF-7243 (eng-runtime) priority=P1 owner=@samir labels=[streaming,poc,helio]

samir: I can hot-toggle send_fragment_sentinel=true for their staging routing key. Low risk.

aria: customer approved. Please flip and monitor.

samir: toggled at 2026-03-18T15:12Z for helio-staging. Also recommending keepalive override to 15s to reduce proxy flushes.

aria: they ran 20 sessions after toggle: direct-edge = no parse errors; CDN path failures dropped significantly. Demo still GO for tomorrow.

kendall-sales: I'll update Helio: applied low-risk server fix, SDK guidance and timeline coming, and will discuss dedicated capacity pricing as an option.

aria: closing loop, scheduling post-demo retro. :white_check_mark:
